class.name: XML
class.brief_description: Reads and writes XML as dictionaries, and any [Resource] as XML.

method.name: create_root
method.description: Replaces the data with a new, empty root element named [param name] and returns it. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Creates a [Resource] from XML [param text] written by [method serialize]. The class comes from the attribute [code]type[/code] of the root element, or from [param type_hint]. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the text can't be read. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.deserialize(text, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_XML, type_hint, options)[/code].

method.name: find_all
method.description: Returns all elements that match [param path]: element names separated by [code]/[/code], relative to the root element. Returns an empty array if there is no root or no match.

method.name: find_first
method.description: Returns the first element that matches [param path]: element names separated by [code]/[/code], relative to the root element. Returns [code]null[/code] if there is no root or no match.

method.name: get_root
method.description: Returns the root element as an [XMLElement] view, or [code]null[/code] if the document has no root. The view is created on first use and shares the tree: writes through it change [member TextDataFormat.data].

method.name: parse_string
method.description: Parses the XML document [param text] and returns its root element. Returns an empty [Dictionary] and prints the error if the text can't be read. Use [method TextDataFormat.parse] for the error details.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns [param resource] as XML text, with its stored properties, sub-resources and the type marker (attribute [code]type[/code] of the root element [code]<resource>[/code]). [code]null[/code] [param options] uses the project settings [code]filesystem/resources/text_formats/*[/code]. Returns an empty [String] and prints an error if the resource can't be written. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.serialize(resource, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_XML, options)[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] [method stringify] writes element dictionaries; use [method serialize] for resources.

method.name: stringify
method.description: Writes the element [Dictionary] [param data] (see the class description) as an XML document. Without [code]"children"[/code], the [String] in [code]"text"[/code] is the content. [param options] sets the indentation ([member SerializerOptions.indent]), the declaration ([member SerializerOptions.xml_declaration]) and the attribute order ([member SerializerOptions.sort_keys]); [code]null[/code] uses the project settings. Attribute values and text that are not [String]s are converted with [method @GlobalScope.str]. Returns an empty [String] and prints an error if an element has no valid [code]"name"[/code], an attribute name is invalid or a child is neither a [Dictionary] nor text.
